messages:
Mia Chen: FYI candidate NPS slipped to 64% from on-sites last week; recurring themes: vague scorecards and broken invites (zoom placeholders showing).

Amar Patel: Sounds like the ATS -> calendar webhook issue. I saw a couple invites with {zoom_link} literal after the invite template change.

Kelly Thompson: One candidate waited in lobby 10m because their invite was empty. Not good.

Jordan Lee: @Amar can you paste the webhook payload you captured?

Amar Patel: payload snippet:
```
{
  "candidate_id":"C-1234",
  "panel":[],
  "zoom_invite":null
}
```
Panel empty -> renderer returned no link; invite service then dropped field. Also saw zoom-service 500 when organizer null.

OpsBot: [automated] ATS integration: webhook delivery failed for candidate C-1234 (500).

Rebecca Owens: Proposed triage: 1) fallback so invites always show a join URL, 2) make key scorecard fields required, 3) run a 30-min interviewer calibration this week. Volunteers?

Kelly Thompson: I'll do calibration. Please make 'role fit' and 'decision rationale' required on scorecards.

Mia Chen: +1. Also add a 3-item checklist to invites: 1) open scorecard, 2) use rubric v2, 3) submit within 24h. Small friction but helps.

Amar Patel: I'll open PR for fallback invite template and add a server-side guard so empty panel arrays don't remove zoom link. PR #3429. ETA EOD tomorrow. Logs tag: zoom_template_render_error.

Jordan Lee: I'll add an alert: if zoom invite failures > 3/hr create incident and ping eng-oncall.

Rebecca Owens: I'll schedule calibration Thu 3pm PT and drop a short doc in People Ops resources, will link here.

Kelly Thompson: Also planning a one-slide for hiring managers on scorecard expectations and interviewer prep. Short + shareable.

Mia Chen: Action items recap: Amar -> PR + fallback, Jordan -> monitor + alert, Rebecca -> schedule + doc, Kelly -> one-slide. I'll follow up tomorrow with status. :thumbsup:
